title: Java-Go protocol v1, feedback parts one through three

complete.description: True proves the full transferred tree is known. False may only authorize resuming the original operation when safeToResume is true and all prior writes have a determinate outcome.

safeToResume.description: When complete is false, true proves every issued write has a determinate result and all remaining steps were not sent. It never authorizes creating a new logical transfer operation.
